specName: Operators Managed by a Root Operator

FR-001.title: The root operator MUST be the single username in the `Frunchy:RootOperator` setting. An empty setting means no root. The old `Frunchy:Operators` setting MUST no

FR-002.title: An operator MUST be the root, or a user listed as an operator in the database. The check MUST NOT add a query to a request: it joins the user lookup each signed

FR-003.title: Operators MUST keep everything feature 007 gives them: the review pages and actions.

FR-004.title: The site MUST serve a root-only operators page at `/review/operators`, listing each operator's username, display name, who added them, and when, plus the root s

FR-005.title: The root MUST be able to add an operator by username, and remove one.

FR-006.title: Adding or removing MUST require a sign-in within the last 10 minutes, using the existing re-confirmation flow.

FR-007.title: The operators page and its actions MUST answer "page not found" (404) to everyone but the root, before any form is read. They are never rate-limited for anyone

FR-008.title: Adding the root, an unknown username or an existing operator, or removing someone who isn't an operator, MUST change nothing and show a notice saying why (post/

FR-009.title: Every addition and removal MUST be recorded in the security activity of both the root (or the server, for the terminal) and the affected user.

FR-010.title: The account page MUST tell operators "You're an operator" with the review link. It MUST show the root a link to the operators page too.

FR-011.title: `operator-add`, `operator-remove` and `operator-list` MUST run the same code as the page, with the same refusals.

FR-012.title: Deleting a user MUST remove their operator status.

FR-013.title: Every visible text MUST come from the site's English and Spanish texts. The page MUST use the shared design system and work from 360px wide.

FR-014.title: The extension's API contract MUST NOT change. The docs MUST describe `Frunchy:RootOperator`, replacing `Frunchy:Operators`.
